(1) the shading problem in TFPV arrays can be solved by a radial panel design, (2) the radial panel design can increase the output power of the panel under shading conditions, and (3) the radial design is robust to various shading scenarios, and is applicable to both amorphous silicon and cadmium telluride technologies.
the radial panel design is superior to the conventional design in terms of reliability and performance.
